title: Inkling 2 Mini: 24-layer MoE (128 experts, top 8) looped to 48 applications, relative-bias attention with per-token sinks, NVFP4 and MXFP8 experts; no decode flow yet
open_questions: no install and no decode flow yet; the Metal kernels exist and are parity-tested in isolation
the CPU reference matched llama.cpp (top-1 19/19, mean KL 4.2e-4 on 19 tokens), which is a correctness check, not a lab measurement (docs/INKLING2_PHASE0.md)
decode bytes per token are an estimate (about 5 GB, BF16 attention dominant), not a measurement
traps: layers 6-17 run three times per token: per-layer stats, prefetch keyed on layer + 1, and the router histogram all assume one application per layer
MXFP8 is layers 20-23, not the full-attention layers 5, 11, 17, 23
the router logits must be F32: llama.cpp runs this router in F32, and FP16 can flip a near-tie
